title: fix(plugin-auth): report at `error` when a `single`-posture deployment holds more than one organization (#17010)
body:
Fixes #17010

Clause-②: no

_(declaration line written by the `domain:services` review seat, not by the implementer — the `Clause-②:` line is the claim's, and `Check Changeset` reads it only as a line-initial literal in this body; a prose or quoted mention is "a near miss, not a declaration". Measured on THIS diff rather than predicted from the card: **0** added lines containing `export`, **0** new `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` / `code:` entries, **0** added `throw`s. This adds a boot-time diagnostic — it accepts nothing new, refuses nothing new, publishes no symbol and changes no wire field. ⛔ Do not delete this line; the gate re-reads the body on the next `edited` event, so removing it re-reds the PR.)_

ADR-0131 §1.2(3) states, verbatim: 「The measured leak's precondition — many organizations with Layer 0 inert — is today a refused boot (ADR-0093 D5, cloud#1020, cloud#1664).」 **It is not.** A deployment that never REQUESTS a walled posture and simply HOLDS more than one `sys_organization` row under `single` boots, serves, and says nothing.

## What changed

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/tenancy-service.ts` takes a `count(sys_organization)` census and reports at **`error`** when a non-walled deployment holds more than one, naming the posture it DECLARED, the count it HOLDS, and the two remedies the card spells out (declare a walled posture, or hold one organization).

**⛔ The boot is NOT refused.** This only reports — the dispatching seat's ruling for this card, 2026-09-10: making the state visible restores a declared invariant and takes nothing away from anyone, whereas actually refusing the boot would stop deployments that run today (the card's own measured instance, `objectstack-ai/ats`, is one). That fork stays open and is the maintainer's; nothing here has to be undone if the answer is "refuse". The per-write `ambiguous-organization` refusal (#8844) is untouched — it is this card's evidence, not its target.

## Why the reading lives on `TenancyService.defaultOrgId()` and not in a new boot hook

That is the seam the card names as silent, it already reads `sys_organization`, and it already knows the REQUESTED posture — so the census needs no second reader and no second store read to keep in step with.

It is reached **at boot** on a default deployment: `AuthPlugin` registers a `kernel:ready` hook that runs `backfillMemberships` with `resolveTargetOrg: () => tenancy.defaultOrgId()`, and the membership policy gating it defaults to `auto` (`AuthManager.getMembershipPolicy()` returns `this.config.membershipPolicy ?? 'auto'`). That claim is not asserted in prose only — it is pinned against the real `backfillMemberships` pass in the suite, so the day the wiring stops reaching this seam, the test says so. A deployment that opts out of that pass (`OS_SKIP_MEMBERSHIP_BACKFILL=1`, or an `invite-only` policy) takes the census at the first single-posture organization resolution instead — still once per process, still before anybody has been mis-bound.

The alternative placement — a new `kernel:ready` probe wired from `auth-plugin.ts`, the shape `boot-sign-in-reachability.ts` uses — was NOT taken: `auth-plugin.ts` is outside this card's declared file surface and is held by open draft PR #17443.

## The cost of the reading

One `count(sys_organization)` per process — one `SELECT COUNT(*)`, via `IDataEngine.count`, over a table whose population under `single` is by definition one row (N greater than one IS the defect being reported).

- A **walled** posture pays **zero**: the census sits downstream of the existing `postureEnforcesWall` early return. Pinned (`engine.count` asserted never called for both `group` and `isolated`).
- A **healthy** deployment reaches it **exactly once**: it also sits downstream of the memoized resolution. Pinned (three `defaultOrgId()` calls, one `count()`).
- An engine that **cannot answer** — every reduced mock embedding, any engine with no `count` — pays nothing and stays silent, and the census is **not latched**, so a store that comes up later is still censused. Pinned.
- **No connection is needed that this path did not already need**: the read goes through the same lazily-resolved `deps.getEngine()` the existing `sys_organization` read uses. Nothing was added at `init()`, where the engine is not yet resolvable.

## Negative control

**Exactly one organization under `single` stays silent**, and so does a store with none yet — pinned as two separate tests, because a check that fires on a healthy install is worse than no check. Both stayed GREEN under the ablation below, which is the point: they do not depend on the check existing.

## Ablation

Mutation: the census call removed from `defaultOrgId()`, on the committed tree (`7c6720e9e`).

- On-disk proof, not an exit code: marker `if (!organizationCensusTaken) {` counted **1 before, 0 after**; blob `9db367209c21a7bf0052561260c71520309e787e` became `439b3dc2d08267734d4b1157adfaeb8f77b2505a`.
- Result: **6 failed | 28 passed (34)**, every failure `AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times` — the six that assert the report fires, including the boot-reachability pin. The negative controls stayed green.
- Restoration proven **BY STATE**: `git diff HEAD` empty, and `git hash-object` back to `9db367209c21a7bf0052561260c71520309e787e` — equal to the HEAD blob. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- path` from an `EXIT INT TERM` trap holding an absolute path.

## Verification

Run at `0126be826`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/tenancy-service.test.ts` — **34 passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` — **exit 0** (includes `check:test-typecheck`, which is what covers the test layer here: the package tsconfig excludes `**/*.test.ts`).
- Gates derived from the ACTUAL diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (3 changed paths), reconciled with `--ran`: **60 commands, 58 exit 0, 2 exit 3**.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` both exit **3 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET** (they read built output of the whole tree). Recorded as **NOT MEASURED**, ⛔ not as a pass — CI builds the closure and measures them.
- Two families run because the diff implicates them even though the derivation did not name them: `pnpm check:optional-error-sink` — **exit 0** (the new sink is in its census: optional `error` beside a REQUIRED `warn`), and `pnpm check:durability-log-level` — **exit 0**.
- Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the lint workflow) are CI's run, not this branch's.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0131 §1.2(3) is still factually wrong after this lands, and arguably more so** — it says the precondition "is today a refused boot"; this builds a REPORT. `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface and a code PR editing it is exactly what that guardrail stops, so it is named here and routed to the PM as its own card rather than fixed in this diff.
- The census is deliberately **module-private**: it has exactly one caller and it is in the same file, so nothing new is published through the package barrel. The exported surface of `tenancy-service.ts` is byte-identical to `origin/main` — which is also what keeps the dispatch's `Clause-②: no` declaration true.
- A DEGRADED walled deployment (a wall requested, the runtime absent) is not censused here: `defaultOrgId()` returns `null` before any read, and ADR-0093 D5 already refuses that boot. Observation only, no card.
